basic_info.description: Rent is Negotiable. Rent covers utilities and parking. Another option- Furnished Rental for Working Professionals - Utilities included in Rent We have a spacious, fully furnished rental available, perfect for working professionals looking for comfort and convenience. Utilities like water, sewage, and gas are included in the rentso no extra bills to worry about! Here are the details of the available rooms and living spaces: Master Bedroom Rent: $1,900/month Features: Good-sized room with a private attached bathroom Includes: closet and furniture Second Bedroom Rent: $1,700/month Features: Good-sized room with closet Bathroom: Shared with only one other tenant (detached bathroom) Living Area Space Rent: $1,400/month Features: Private/separated space within the living area Includes: Large wardrobe, furnished with a bed frame Additional Amenities: Fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, washer, and dryer included Ready to move in no need to buy your own appliances or furniture Quiet, professional-friendly environment If you're interested or want to see photos or schedule a visit, feel free to reach out!
